name: Hidden Volume Removal using Hierarchical Occlusion Maps
aliases: Hidden Volume Removal using Hierarchical Occlusion Maps (HOMs)
definition: An occlusion culling method using Hierarchical Occlusion Maps (HOMs) to skip hidden nodes in the min-max octree, compensating for the lack of early ray termination in object-order rendering.
summary: Hidden Volume Removal uses Hierarchical Occlusion Maps to skip hidden octree nodes in object-order rendering, offering superior skipping efficiency compared to orthogonal opacity maps.
